items.body:
### Summary

When I run the sanity tests on a pre-release of my collection (12.0.0-dev0), the sanity tests fail because
`ERROR: meta/runtime.yml:0:0: The tombstone removal_version ('12.0.0') must not be after the current version (SemanticVersion('12.0.0-dev0')) for dictionary value @ data['plugin_routing']['modules']['aws_waf_condition']['tombstone']['removal_version']. Got '12.0.0'`

This feels like a false-positive.

### Issue Type

Bug Report

### Component Name

ansible-test

### Ansible Version

```console
[WARNING]: You are running the development version of Ansible. You should only run Ansible from "devel" if you are modifying the Ansible engine, or trying out features under development. This is a rapidly changing source of code and can become unstable at any point.
ansible [core 2.21.0.dev0] (devel 8d24f0d32f) last updated 2026/03/31 11:59:41 (GMT +200)
  config file = /etc/ansible/ansible.cfg
  configured module search path = ['/home/mchappel/.ansible/plugins/modules', '/usr/share/ansible/plugins/modules']
  ansible python module location = /home/mchappel/vcs/ansible/ansible/lib/ansible
  ansible collection location = /home/mchappel/.ansible/collections:/usr/share/ansible/collections
  executable location = /home/mchappel/vcs/ansible/ansible/bin/ansible
  python version = 3.14.3 (main, Feb  4 2026, 00:00:00) [GCC 15.2.1 20260123 (Red Hat 15.2.1-7)] (/home/mchappel/vcs/ansible/virtualenvs/ansible-dev314/bin/python)
  jinja version = 3.1.6
  pyyaml version = 6.0.3 (with libyaml v0.2.5)
```

### Configuration

```console
# if using a version older than ansible-core 2.12 you should omit the '-t all'
$ ansible-config dump --only-changed -t all
```

### OS / Environment

Fedora

### Steps to Reproduce

- Set the current version to a pre-release
- Add a tombstone for the major version
- run the sanity tests


### Expected Results

Sanity test passes

### Actual Results

```console
ERROR: meta/runtime.yml:0:0: The tombstone removal_version ('12.0.0') must not be after the current version (SemanticVersion('12.0.0-dev0')) for dictionary value @ data['plugin_routing']['modules']['aws_waf_condition']['tombstone']['removal_version']. Got '12.0.0'
```
